items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah, Fuchs probably. Fuchs, yeah, Fuchs. And the biggest foot in the city of the Orleans. Yeah. Fuchs about that big.

ctx.x: You mean on clarinet? Oh, clarinet? Let me see. Here, I see. I see on clarinet. I see Percy. Oh, yeah. He's dead too. Crombone? Crombone. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I don't think we had a trombone player out there. No, we didn't have no trombone player. Didn't Foster used to play with him? Who? Foster. No, not out there. No. No, but he had Foster and dudes with him too, you know, after he broke up the band. But we went over to Biloxi. Let me see who he had. I just remember who we had. I was just hired on that job, you…
That place on Howard Avenue you're talking about, I can't think of the name of it, where they used to go jam? At a sporting house upstairs or something?
